payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Create a flat, 2D interface with bold colors, no shadows/gradients, clean lines, simple geometric shapes, icon-heavy, typography-focused, minimal ornamentation. Use 4-6 solid, bright colors in a limited palette with high saturation.
payload.best_for: Web apps, mobile apps, cross-platform, startup MVPs, user-friendly, SaaS, dashboards, corporate
payload.css_technical_keywords: box-shadow: none, background: solid color, border-radius: 0-4px, color: solid (no gradients), fill: solid, stroke: 1-2px, font: bold sans-serif, icons: simplified SVG
payload.design_system_variables: --shadow: none, --color-palette: 4-6 solid, --border-radius: 2px, --gradient: none, --icons: simplified SVG, --animation: minimal 150-200ms
payload.do_not_use_for: Complex 3D, premium/luxury, artistic portfolios, immersive experiences, high-detail
payload.effects_and_animation: No gradients/shadows, simple hover (color/opacity shift), fast loading, clean transitions (150-200ms ease), minimal icons
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ No shadows/gradients, ☐ 4-6 solid colors max, ☐ Clean lines consistent, ☐ Simple shapes used, ☐ Icon-heavy layout, ☐ High saturation colors, ☐ Fast loading verified
payload.keywords: 2D, minimalist, bold colors, no shadows, clean lines, simple shapes, typography-focused, modern, icon-heavy
payload.primary_colors: Solid bright: Red, Orange, Blue, Green, limited palette (4-6 max)
payload.secondary_colors: Complementary colors, muted secondaries, high saturation, clean accents
